title: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. Announces Sale of Gravitas Life Sciences, LLC
summary: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc., (NASDAQ: CNTN) ("Canton Strategic Holdings" or the "Company") the first publicly traded company to leverage Canton Coin to support the Canton Network's ability to digitize traditional financial markets, today announced the sale of its biotech research and development arm, Gravitas Life Sciences, LLC ("Gravitas"), to Gravitas Collective Corp. The transaction was approved unanimously by the Board of Directors and closed on July 17, 2026.
